title: Anwar Rais v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Naheed Ara Moonis and Dinesh Pathak, JJ.
disposition: Writ disposed; EE to decide objection after hearing; coercive action stayed six weeks
headnote: A s.126 provisional assessment cannot be treated as final or enforced by recovery without considering the consumer's objection and affording a hearing under s.126(3) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and clause 8.1 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Following Shishir Jain, the Court directed the Executive Engineer to decide the petitioner's 18 August 2020 objection by a reasoned speaking order within four weeks and stayed coercive action on the 1 December 2020 recovery demand for six weeks or until that decision, whichever was earlier.
facts: The petitioner held a 7 HP connection and claimed regular payment of charges. A vigilance inspection on 23 June 2020 alleged illegal use of electricity. A provisional assessment issued on 30 June 2020; he objected on 18 August 2020. The licensee treated the provisional assessment as final for want of a timely objection and issued a recovery demand on 1 December 2020. He sought certiorari against both notices and a mandamus against disconnection.

holding_units.holding: Where an objection to a s.126 provisional assessment has been filed, the assessing officer cannot treat that provisional assessment as final and issue recovery without considering the objection and giving a hearing, as required by s.126(3) of the Electricity Act, 2003 and clause 8.1 of the Supply Code, 2005. The Executive Engineer was directed to decide the 18.8.2020 objection by a reasoned speaking order on final assessment within four weeks after hearing the petitioner; coercive action on the 1.12.2020 recovery demand was stayed for six weeks or until that decision, whichever was earlier.

principle_tags.application: Applied Shishir Jain: without a final assessment after considering the objection and hearing the consumer, recovery of the provisional assessment cannot be compelled; the EE was directed to decide the 18.8.2020 objection after hearing.

lead_authorities.name: Shishir Jain v. Paschimanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Ltd.

not_decided.point: Merits of the alleged unauthorized use and the quantum of assessment
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer on the 18.8.2020 objection.

not_decided.point: Whether the 18.8.2020 objection was within the time allowed for objecting to the provisional assessment
not_decided.note: The licensee asserted it was late; the Court did not decide the time-bar and directed the objection to be considered.
